title: Verify all constraints before answering
guidance: If the question contains multiple identifying details (year, duration, color, location), verify ALL of them using GetAttributeDetails before proceeding. Do not assume the first entity match is correct without checking constraints.

title: Trust verified KB data over intuition
guidance: Once you have verified a fact through KB tools (e.g., COUNT returned 3, or GetAttributeDetails returned a value), trust that result. Do NOT second-guess or downgrade your confidence after verification. Tool results are ground truth.

title: Match the correct qualifier when multiple exist
guidance: Relations and attributes often have multiple qualifiers (point_in_time, for_work, ceremony, location, role). Parse the question word (When/Where/What role/What ceremony) to select the RIGHT qualifier from GetEdgeQualifiers results.

title: Use FindByAttribute for unique identifiers
guidance: When the question contains a unique code, ID, URL, or ISNI, use FindByAttribute for exact reverse lookup. It is faster and more accurate than semantic search with FindNode.

title: Prefer CountEntities for any 'How many?' question
guidance: CountEntities returns the EXACT integer count via SPARQL COUNT(DISTINCT) and is the FIRST tool to reach for. Never use FilterEntities + len(matches) -- it silently truncates at limit=50 and returns the wrong number. For OR conditions ('X has Y>A or Y<B'), pass the second branch through or_conditions=[{...}] instead of writing UNION SPARQL by hand. For 'all mammals' or any concept with subtypes, use transitive_concept=True. Hand-written COUNT SPARQL via RunSPARQL is the LAST resort, only for 3+ relation-hop joins.

title: Prefer SelectExtreme for SelectAmong / SelectBetween
guidance: SelectExtreme returns the actual winner via SPARQL ORDER BY -- do NOT make the LLM eyeball values from CompareEntities. For SelectAmong over a typed group: pass concept + attribute_name + mode='max'|'min'. For SelectBetween over two known entities: pass entity_ids=[id_A, id_B] + attribute_name + mode. For dates, mode='min' = earliest = older. CompareEntities is fine for diagnostic display but SelectExtreme is the answer-producing call.

title: Prefer VerifyFact for fact-existence checks
guidance: VerifyFact(subject_id, predicate, target) does a single SPARQL ASK and returns a clean TRUE/FALSE. Use it instead of GetAttributeDetails-then-interpret-empty-as-no. predicate_type='auto' tries attribute first, then relation. For numeric or date COMPARISONS still use GetAttributeDetails -> VerifyNumericCondition.
